docker_healthcheck_command: python3 -c "import urllib.request, sys; sys.exit(0 if getattr(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health', timeout=3), 'status', None) == 200 else 1)"

semantics.distinction: HTTP 200 confirms the WSGI web process is accepting HTTP connections. System data readiness is inspected separately via response capabilities matrix ('prices', 'benchmarks', 'economics'). Unavailable forecast/advice is an intentional fail-closed research guard, not a process failure.
